description: You are a civil engineer at a transportation consulting firm hired by the City of Bologna to design a traffic calming zone in the Acosta corridor residential area. Residents have complained about speeding vehicles on local streets. The city wants to implement a 30 km/h zone (Zone 30) on at least 8 residential edges while ensuring that arterial throughput on the main corridors is not significantly degraded. Using the SUMO simulation tools, you must: (1) Run the existing Bologna Acosta simulation as a baseline and record key metrics (average speed, travel times, total throughput). Save baseline tripinfo to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_tripinfos.xml. (2) Identify residential edges in the network (typically shorter, single-lane edges with lower speed limits) and modify at least 8 of them to have a maximum speed of 30 km/h (8.33 m/s) using netedit or by editing the network XML directly with netconvert. Save the modified network. (3) Optionally add traffic calming features: add speed bumps by reducing edge speeds further to 20 km/h on at least 2 edges, or add turn restrictions. (4) Run the modified simulation and save tripinfo to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/calming_tripinfos.xml. (5) Produce a before-after comparison report at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/traffic_calming_report.csv with columns: metric,baseline_value,calming_value,change_pct. Required metrics: zone_avg_speed (average speed on modified edges), corridor_avg_travel_time (average travel time for all vehicles), total_throughput (vehicles completing trips), zone_85th_percentile_speed, corridor_avg_speed. (6) Write a professional engineering summary to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/traffic_calming_summary.txt documenting the zone design, expected speed reductions, and impact on arterial traffic. The scenario is at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/.
